supporting_observations.claim: The alerted periodic HTTPS activity in the available records is associated by timing and process telemetry with ChartMate's cmupdate.exe: it started from the user's AppData\Local\ChartMate directory, and the same process connected to the proxy as it recorded CONNECT requests to update.chartmate-imaging.net from 13:38 through 14:08 UTC.

The CONNECT attempts recur at roughly five-minute intervals in the observed portion of the alert window. Some were unsuccessful (407 at 13:43 and 502 at 13:52); the other cited requests returned status 200.

The observed updater path and requested hostname differ from the inventory's stated ChartMate updater path and check domain (C:\Program Files\ChartMate\cmupdate.exe and update.chartmate-imaging.com). This discrepancy is suspicious but does not by itself establish that the executable or domain is malicious.

At 13:38, Sysmon recorded a file-create event targeting the same AppData\Local\ChartMate\cmupdate.exe path shortly after the process started and made its first observed connection. The record does not establish the file's contents or provenance.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show HTTPS CONNECT destinations and status, but the supplied records do not show TLS certificate details, decrypted request contents, or downloaded payload contents.
The supplied evidence does not include a file hash, digital-signature verification, or software installation/provenance data for the AppData copy of cmupdate.exe.
The provided records show the periodic requests from 13:38 to 14:08 UTC, but do not establish the full connection history for the entire alert interval.
claims_not_established: Whether update.chartmate-imaging.net is a legitimate ChartMate alias or an impersonating destination.
Whether the AppData\Local\ChartMate\cmupdate.exe file is authentic, authorized, or tampered with.
Whether any update or other content was successfully downloaded, executed, or transferred.
Whether the periodic activity was malicious.
additional_evidence_needed: Verify the .net hostname with ChartMate or an authoritative vendor source and review its DNS, registration, reputation, and TLS certificate history.
Acquire the updater file and verify its hash, signature, origin, and comparison with an approved ChartMate installer or known-good endpoint.
Review proxy/TLS inspection and endpoint file/process telemetry for the contents and outcome of the 13:38–14:08 requests, including any subsequent file execution or installation.
unrelated_findings: FILE-HD-01 recorded an SMB network logon as ANONYMOUS LOGON from WS-BCARTER-01. This is separate from the alerted HTTPS activity and should be reviewed independently. (T015-00253, T015-00257)
